rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a person who designs things or does design professionally.

example.english: That designer made a poster for me.
example.traditional: 嗰個設計師幫我整咗張海報。
example.jyutping: go2 go3 cit3 gai3 si1 bong1 ngo5 zing2 zo2 zoeng1 hoi2 bou3

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for designer fashion or other branded luxury goods.

example.english: This designer handbag is really nice.
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 ming4 paai4 sau2 doi6 gei2 leng3

rows.note: Use this when designer means upscale or luxurious and the item need not be made by a designer.

example.english: We booked a designer hotel for this trip.
example.traditional: 我哋今次旅行訂咗間高級酒店。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gam1 ci3 leoi5 hang4 deng6 zo2 gaan1 gou1 kap1 zau2 dim3

rows.jyutping: jau4 cit3 gai3 si1 cit3 gai3 ge3 N
rows.note: Use this when you specifically mean that a designer created the item, rather than merely that it is expensive or branded.

example.english: This chair was designed by a designer.
example.traditional: 呢張椅係由設計師設計嘅。
example.jyutping: ni1 zoeng1 ji2 hai6 jau4 cit3 gai3 si1 cit3 gai3 ge3

rows.note: Use this for software used to create or modify designs, rather than for the person who designs them.

example.english: This design software is very convenient for a designer making posters.
example.traditional: 呢個設計軟件好方便，做海報好快。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 cit3 gai3 jyun5 gin6 hou2 fong1 bin6 zou6 hoi2 bou3 hou2 faai3
